entries.title: A Google Director Open-Sourced His Claude Skills
entries.summary: Google Director Addy Osmani open-sourced his entire 23-file SKILL.md agent workflow at github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills (51K stars), free to clone today. The standout skill instructs agents to doubt and re-check their own work before shipping, and the full library ports to Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode via a single 10-byte symlink.

entries.title: What Comes After LLMs ??
entries.summary: Yann LeCun's V-JEPA paper reveals the next AI bottleneck: current LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini) lack a real world model — they predict text but cannot reason about how the physical world actually works. V-JEPA tests video-based joint embedding to begin filling this gap, pointing toward world models as the foundation for post-LLM AI.

Prompt Engineering Skills Real AI Engineers Need
entries.summary: Tech With Tim argues that prompt engineering is one of the most critical skills for AI engineers in 2026, distinguishing between casual chat use and reliable production deployments. The key techniques are: writing system prompts that genuinely constrain model behavior, using function calling to return machine-readable structured data, and applying JSON mode for predictable parsable outputs.

The integration combines Claude's AI-driven commands with Canva's full design editing suite, representing the broader trend of AI and design tool convergence for marketing and content creation.

entries.title: STOP using Claude until you know this!
Turn Claude Code into a Production Studio with Open Montage 🚀 #AI #ClaudeCode #Automation #devtools

It orchestrates the entire video production process — from web research and scripting through AI asset generation, editing, and Remotion composition — with real-footage documentary support and costs as low as $0.15 per video.

entries.title: The 3 Biggest Mistakes People Make Building AI Agents  #techtok #tech #agent

The video argues that fixing these three issues alone puts builders ahead of 90% of the field.

entries.title: This One Tool Makes Claude Code Way Cheaper to Run

entries.title: 5 CLAUDE PROMPTS THAT RUN MY 8-HOUR WORKDAY IN 47 MINUTES
